basis: One entry per dataset whose installed policy is marked receipts_retired (subject_catalog.RECEIPTS_RETIRED): the last generation its family published with per-row ETL receipts, which holds the only complete copy of them. Weekly retention keeps every generation a file under docs/ cites by eight or more hex digits, so this file keeps each one for good; tests/test_receipt_archive_pins.py holds every retired dataset to an entry here. Never delete an entry: it is the archive's only pin.
